study_population.duplicate_label_policy: one row per chan_id; for duplicated P-2 keep the first source-CSV row, matching the existing V2 drop_duplicates(keep='first') convention

development_split.fit_use: model fitting, target scaling, fit-only feature/graph selection

sensitivity_scorer.name: causal_ewma
sensitivity_scorer.initialization: z0=s0 separately for calibration and evaluation score blocks

calibration.threshold_scope: model x channel x seed x scorer; persistence is deterministic and calibrated once per channel
calibration.near_constant_policy: do not alter the rule; record distinct-score count, constant-score flag, and threshold-is-maximum flag

events.predicted_event: maximal consecutive run of alarmed target indices
events.boundary_policy: intersect annotations with scored domain; boundary-crossing events remain detection-eligible but left-censored events are excluded from delay summaries

mandatory_secondary_metrics: Hundman-style overlap event precision/recall/F0.5 under common protocol
false alarm runs per 10000 nominal samples
detection delay summaries excluding left-censored events

aggregation.mission_event_counts: sum channel counts within seed before metric calculation
aggregation.seed_summary: compute each seed separately then arithmetic mean

uncertainty.formal_multiplicity: Holm across two primary contrasts x two missions if formal significance claims are made

freeze_requirements: checkpoint_manifest.csv exists and readiness audit passes
thresholds.csv generated using TRAIN calibration only
protocol, code, checkpoint manifest and thresholds are hashed before TEST score export
TEST score export must not read anomaly labels
evaluate_locked.py is the sole anomaly-label reader in this package
